services.title: Towing
services.body: Vehicles and equipment are secured and moved the way the load actually calls for.

reviews.author: victoria dodge
reviews.text: Doug is an amazing human being. He is caring and understanding, and was super helpful to me during a moment of crisis when I got a flat up on the mountain. He is fast, communicative, and he has such a kind heart. I cannot thank you enough, Doug. God bless you.

reviews.author: Don Curtis
reviews.text: How many towing companies have you seen with a 4.8 rating? That alone speaks volumes, but I feel compelled to write this review because he went above and beyond for me. First, he picks up and drops off exactly when he says he will. It sounds basic, but in the towing industry, it’s the exception. I had been waiting for a AAA towing company for six hours. At 9:00 PM, the owner answered the phone himself. He assured me that if AAA didn’t contact me, I should call him first thing in the morning, and he would come get me. I called him the next morning, and he was at my house by 8:30 AM to tow my Porsche Macan to Asheville. While he was nearly at the dealer, I called and asked if we could switch drop-off locations because I found a great independent shop. It was no problem for him, and that probably saved me at least $1,000 in repairs. I can’t say enough about this guy. Well done and thank you.

reviews.author: Violette Steel
reviews.text: Doug is the real deal. He took care of me and had my back after I was involved in an accident, and the not at fault party. He was personable, honest, more than fair, and solid. I would recommend anyone to him, and will.

reviews.author: Lauri Etter
reviews.text: My car was sitting near the bottom of our very steep, long, icy driveway. I had slid into the embankment the previous evening trying to get home. After shoveling snow and ice for hours, my car would not start due to a dead battery. I called Auto MD and Doug came by soon after and got the car started again. He was very kind and professional, and he also moved my car to a safer, non icy area. I highly recommend Auto MD services!

reviews.author: Christiane P
reviews.text: We called the company in the morning to ask if they could tow my car because the alternator is dead. They said it was a busy day but they would show up after lunch. At 5 PM I called them and got a phone message saying that they were closed at four. They never tried contacting us via phone text or anything to let us know what was going on so we couldn’t get our car to the mechanic to get it fixed so we could get to work. Very discouraged at the lack of service this company gave us.

reviews.author: Sean Friedman
reviews.text: My cars axle broke and Doug was the first option that came across when looking for a tow. He was beyond professional and personal. He was able to get my car to the shop in a quick and timely fashion while also maintaining contact throughout the whole process. If I ever need a tow for sure calling Auto MD first. Thank you for everything!!

reviews.author: Bill Crigger
reviews.text: My family and I just returned from a weekend trip to Brevard NC, a beautiful place. While there we had a flat tire in the hotel parking lot. I called Auto M.D. and they were quick to respond. Doug came out and got us on the road again. He was an outstanding guy whom I enjoyed talking to. Thank you Auto M.D. and Doug we owe you one. Highly recommend for all auto needs including towing.

reviews.author: Alayna Crigger
reviews.text: My family and I were out of town in Brevard, and we ended up getting a flat tire. My dad called Auto MD, and Doug was eager to be of help to us! He came to our hotel and got us going. Very professional and personable! Highly Recommended.

reviews.author: Lloyd Smith
reviews.text: It's no surprise to me AutoMD has such a high rating and from my experience it's because Doug's a top-notch professional who carries out his work with genuine care and kindness. I'm so thankful he was the man on the scene to my horrible car wreck and even more grateful for all he did to go over and above in helping me sort it all out afterwards. If you're in the area and you need any sort of towing assistance then look no further and give them a call!

reviews.author: Mark Semler
reviews.text: What a life-saver. We felt stranded with no one else coming to help and Doug found the time and showed up. Fixed my tire for a reasonable price and was key to getting my family home safe that day! Can't thank them enough, total pros.

reviews.author: Chase Woodward
reviews.text: Genuine people that are very good at what they do and care about helping others. If you need a tow around the surrounding Brevard area, don't hesitate to call! When my car broke down off the side of the road they were incredibly prompt and professional in getting it moved. Thank you! You deserve more than 5 stars for how skillfully you backed up my steep and narrow driveway up a mountain.

reviews.author: Thomas Whitmire
reviews.text: Auto MD is our excellent new go-to towing company. Doug promptly responded to our request, proactively called, and came out with a friendly smile, dedicated work ethic, and beautiful new truck. Thanks for your excellent service!

reviews.author: Richard Ness
reviews.text: Excellent towing company. Our truck broke down on the way to DuPont State Park. Auto MD arrived quickly, helped us to diagnose the mechanical issue, and quickly gave us a ride to the auto repair shop. These guys are great!

reviews.author: andrew schulz
reviews.text: melanie and doug got us taken care of when we broke down on our way through brevard. even with short staff, they got our vehicle to a local shop quickly and at a great value. sadly, we needed a second tow a couple days later, and auto md came to the rescue again and even sent some personal items left in the vehicle back to us. highly recommend as first choice for wrecker service, communication was always clear and prompt and friendly.

reviews.author: Kaz
reviews.text: To Doug the owner: Thank you for your prompt and professional towing service and texting me just before your arrival. I asked you for a receipt when I payed for the tow and you replied yes and got my email and said it will be done tomorrow. Three days went by and I retexted you all the info with no reply on your end. I've checked my email and spam folder - no receipt. I need the receipt to be reimbursed by my auto insurance for the tow. I'm writing this review one week after the tow. I told you the day of the tow that I would give you a review and unlike you, I kept my word.

reviews.author: John D
reviews.text: After other companies promised to fix our flat tire for AAA but never called or showed up, Auto MD of WNC called, came out at the time promised, and quickly solved our problem. I highly recommend the quality of their equipment, service, and employees.

reviews.author: Eduardo Crespo
reviews.text: My car broke down during the 4th of July weekend while I was enjoying a drive at the NC mountains with wife and dog. I was able to contact Doug at Auto MD and he not only provide us a tow service but also helped us find an excellent auto repair shop that fixed the car, so we could drive back to our rented cabin in a nearby town and then to our home in GA.

reviews.author: Debbie Highsmith
reviews.text: I used Auto MD through AAA for a flat tire. I was a senior woman alone in a parking lot with a blown out tire. The service kept me informed of ETA and the owner serviced my car with empathy and efficiency. Thank you!

reviews.author: Sheila Vrana
reviews.text: New to the Brevard area - our car had an electrical failure and needed to be towed to Asheville. Doug arrived, diagnosed the issue and had our car on the flatbed truck in 5 minutes- all the while putting us at ease with his engaging personality. We are delighted with the addition of this excellent business to the Brevard area!

reviews.author: Carrie Goss
reviews.text: If you ever have car trouble, these are the guys to call! I got off my 10 1/2 hour night shift and my car wouldn’t start. Doug came and helped me figure out the problem in no time!!! I’m a traveling healthcare worker and I was a long way from anything familiar. Thanks again for taking care of me.

reviews.author: Katie Faye Forrest
reviews.text: Doug and Melanie are amazing! Excellent customer service and excellent repair work. I have gone to AutoMD twice now and both times I have been BLOWN AWAY by their service. I am proud to have this business in my community. I really am. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for auto service. Thank you Doug and Melanie!

reviews.author: Kathy Mitchell
reviews.text: Brevard, NC is very fortunate to have Auto MD in the area. Roadside assistance can be challenging in this part of WNC. I have called them twice in the past week (once thru AAA) and their professionalism is the best! The pleasant lady in the office returns calls and is honest about timing. The owner knows what he is doing so is quick, polite, and efficient! Who could ask for better service amid an emergency!

reviews.author: Bryanna Smith
reviews.text: Thanks Doug! We called Auto MD and Doug came right out to us, helping us get on our way in less than 10 minutes. Excellent service and just a genuinely good guy. Thank you!

reviews.author: Kayla Cole
reviews.text: You’re not gonna get prices this good anywhere else!!! Great Service!!! The guy came out very quickly and ready to help me get back into my car after I locked my keys inside. Very nice and I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Bobby Parham
reviews.text: Awesome employees and company! Very quick and professional. The only ones I call for my company's towing needs.

reviews.author: Preston Causey
reviews.text: Never gor his name but boss man was very nice & let me take my time getting my entire life out of my totaled truck. Even helped me charge my phone to call an uber. Thanks!

reviews.author: Kathleen DiLuzio
reviews.text: These folks deserve 10 stars!!! My daughter needed her air conditioner fixed for a long trip and they came through with flying colors. It was a tough job and despite the issues while repairing, they were gracious and so accommodating AND completed it in the time they said. She made her 12 hour trip safe and sound in comfort. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Leslie Taylor
reviews.text: Very reliable and HONEST..they have fixed AC on 2 of my vehicles within last couple months. Originally quoted for an AC compressor ( by the way they are half what another repair place quoted me) for Pilot but ended up being a much cheaper fix. They could have very easily charged me the quoted price and went on about business BUT they did not.

reviews.author: Ian McHarg
reviews.text: Family run shop that offers quick and phenomenal auto work at downright ridiculously low prices. After getting our AC charged for one of the lowest prices in the area, they've spent additional time tracking down multiple leaks around the compressor and fixed them all at no charge. These guys have our business for life!

reviews.author: Tee Corley
reviews.text: Genuine, kind, good humans here! I rolled in with a flat tire and a panic attack and they fixed it straight away for a very, very affordable price. Highly recommend and I will definitely be going back for my car problems!

reviews.author: ashleyaaron switzer
reviews.text: They were so nice! I did my own repair not full and was so anxious since I have kids! They not only fixed my problem but did it at no charge to me! Such nice service great people! I'm making them my official mechanic for my cars!!! Thank you so much!!

reviews.author: Kristie Schrock
reviews.text: Wonderful humans. Have helped me out on numerous occasions. Went to them for new break pads and TIRES for my wife’s vehicle.Very affordable and honest when it comes to what needs to be done. Would highly recommend anyone needing automotive work to check them out.

reviews.author: Jonathan Gillman
reviews.text: Telisha is amazing! So thankful to have had someone so kind, thoughtful, and went out of her way to make sure we were safe and had a solution.

reviews.author: Chris Patterson
reviews.text: I didn't get any auto work done however they towed my car from Etowah to their shop and were asked to tow it to my house in Etowah, only half a mile away... When asked why, they said my wife told them to, which she nor i nor the officer on scene recalls. They are now keeping my car in their "impound" and raised the price from $250 to $330 just because I tried to tell them they were incorrect. This is bad business on every level and boarder line theft.

reviews.author: Ethan Pace
reviews.text: These are the kindest, most hardworking people you will ever meet. No better shop around. Their pricing is incredible, and the work is even more impressive. Will recommend Auto MD to everyone I know!

reviews.author: Violet Elizabeth
reviews.text: Doug showed up quickly and got my car out of the worst spot she’s ever been in, was so kind the whole time and truly blessed me. 1000% recommend

reviews.author: Lisa Cooper
reviews.text: This is a terrific company with great people running it. They were so kind to me and I would highly recommend their services! Check them out if you are ever in the need!

reviews.author: Ivette Vaughn
reviews.text: Starter went out and the owners went above and beyond to get me up and running again. I’ve taken my car here for other repairs and they consistently save me time and money. Great people who do quality work.

reviews.author: Nickelle Crowley
reviews.text: Amazing quick service! Doug thanks for helping with a tow when our truck broke down while we are visiting from out of town. We really appreciate it!

reviews.author: Luke Small
reviews.text: This small family owned and operated garage says they are all about doing it right the first time. As evidence of the vehicles in the shop they handle everything from your minivan to trucks, Porsches and Corvettes!

reviews.author: Krystal Worley
reviews.text: Best mechanic around! Great rates, great work, quick service, and best of all Great people! Family owned and operated, wouldn't take my vehicles anywhere else!

reviews.author: Jay Hinze
reviews.text: Doug is a great communicator. He called me when he was on the way. Very timely and very professional.

reviews.author: stephen
reviews.text: Auto MD was polite Professional and prompt. I have an inspection here and a tune up. Happy to know I have mechanics I can count on!

reviews.author: andrew houchin
reviews.text: Never done business with these guys, but I am glad to see someone is taking better care of people in the Brevard and surrounding areas, compared to what Firehouse was doing.

reviews.author: Evan Hockensmith
reviews.text: Very honest and super nice guy, he will help in any way he can. I would not even look anywhere else, he is hands down the best in the area and most trustworthy!

reviews.author: Mackenzie Kirkpatrick
reviews.text: I’ve always had quality service in a timely manner. After horrifying mechanic experiences around town, I don’t trust anyone else to work on my vehicle.

reviews.author: LEWSTEW TRAVELS.
reviews.text: Operating under new owner, Doug Walker will work with you on all you repairs. Great family business.
